name: elevation-bands-kabini
_provenance: FABDEM V1-2 (Hawker et al., University of Bristol; satellite-derived 30 m DEM with buildings and forests removed) via Google Earth Engine, classified into ground-height bands and clipped to the basin boundary. Simplified for basin-scale display (~110 m tolerance) - read them as bands, not spot heights.
